categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC metadata handling and OpenRPC generation in src/rpc/util.h, src/rpc/server.cpp, and src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds machine-readable OpenRPC discriminator metadata to map getblock verbosity levels to result schemas. As noted in the description, downstream client libraries like corepc and btcd previously had to hardcode this mapping, and verbosity 2 and 3 responses cannot be distinguished by response validation alone. While useful for typed RPC client generators, this is an OpenRPC documentation schema enhancement that can be reasonably deferred without impacting node runtime behavior.
